name: coin-flow
description: Coin Flow - Personal Finance Tracker & Expense Manager

scripts.sync-android: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'db.json', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js', 'icon.png', 'favicon.png', 'icon-192.png', 'icon-512.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join('android/app/src/main/assets', f)); }); console.log('Synced web assets to android app assets directory!');"
